placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Weston Big Wood is a wildlife-rich reserve above Weston-in-Gordano. Its established woodland changes through the year, with spring flowers and autumn leaves offering different reasons to return.

Follow the reserve's trail guide rather than making new paths through the undergrowth. Our family idea: look for different bark textures and fallen leaves, leaving fungi and plants where they grow.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families interested in woodland wildlife and seasonal changes.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: A waymarked walking route; bring drinks and a snack.
placepracticalinfo.parking: There are limited spaces on Valley Road. Avoid blocking access for residents.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The woodland includes slopes, steps and uneven surfaces. Consult the trail guide and wear shoes suited to muddy ground.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Weston Big Wood, Valley Road, Weston-in-Gordano, Portishead, BS20 8PG
placevisitmap.travelNote: There are limited spaces on Valley Road. Avoid blocking access for residents. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
